notes.title: Final Release + Hardware Anforderungen
notes.notes:
[h1]Release[/h1]
After 23 Hours more than 2000 Players added the Game to their Library and over 200 Players already played it.

[h1]Hardwarerequirements[/h1]
Don't try to play this small game with low graphic card. AT LEAST A GTX 1080 is necessary!

notes.title: Giveaway, Release und DLSS
notes.notes:
[h1]Release and Giveaway[/h1]
Steam got my Version.. so we'll wait. Until then I'll stream on twitch.tv/gudeandi and have a giveaway for Early Access Keys.

[h1]Release Date[/h1]
The Releasedate gonne be earlier due to vacation. The new date is [b]28.10.2022[/b] around 8pm.


[h1]DLSS[/h1]
There is now DLSS. Got with my 3080 on 3440x1440 over 50% more FPS.
